label: Genuine message
text: Nitapika wali na mboga leo jioni, unanunua nyama au mimi nibebe?

label: Genuine + phone number
text: Nitapika wali na mboga leo jioni, unanunua nyama au mimi nibebe? Nipigie 0712345678
note: Still passes: the number shortcut is gone (E10-E11).

label: Classic scam
text: Iyo pesa itume kwenye namba hii 0712345678 jina litakuja JUMA ALLY

label: Disguised scam
text: Xо​rrу ni​ро хаf​ari nі​na xh​іda kw​еl nаku​оmbа unіx​а1d1e ѕ​h elfu 9 nіtаku​rеfund nіki​fika р​lх В​y НАМ​І5I RAMADHANI,ni g​rр mеm​bеr
note: Lookalike letters fool the n-gram model; the transformer still flags it (E6).

label: Disguised + defence
text: Xо​rrу ni​ро хаf​ari nі​na xh​іda kw​еl nаku​оmbа unіx​а1d1e ѕ​h elfu 9 nіtаku​rеfund nіki​fika р​lх В​y НАМ​І5I RAMADHANI,ni g​rр mеm​bеr
note: With the normalisation defence on, the n-gram model recovers (E7).

label: Landlord impersonation
text: Habari za asubuhi. Mimi mwenye nyumba wako hii namba yangu ya Vodacom. Mbona kimya na siku zinazidi kwenda...?
note: No number or link: the transformer misses it, the n-gram model catches it (E12).

label: Chichewa scam
text: MIRACLE MONEY: lowani mpingo wathu wa satanic kuti mulemele. imbani phone ku nambala iyi 0999000000 kuti mujoine
note: No Chichewa in training: only the transformer flags it (E8).
